summary: Standing merge-hygiene rules for every agent (OWNER-MERGE-HYGIENE-01, 2026-10-03), after one green PR (#504) had to merge main seven times in a night, every conflict in generated Hub files or the append-only decision log. Part A, in force now: generated Hub files are never hand-edited and their conflicts are resolved by taking main's version and re-rendering; decision-log conflicts keep both sides, main's first; main is merged only just before the final push; a green PR is merged at once; and every agent defers to an open PR labelled merge-priority whose CI is running or green. Part B, switched on by the MERGE-HYGIENE-01 ticket: PRs commit no generated Hub outputs, and decisions are one file each, enforced by CI. A merge queue stays a separate owner decision. No scientific, security or delivery rule changed.
